==Skin Trivia==
*The '''Gladiator''' currently has the most skins for an [[Events|event]] tower.
*Currently no '''Gladiator''' skins share the same weapon.
*The {{Color|Other|Beach}} skin was originally going to be called the ''Ducky'' '''Gladiator'''.
**In a few development images, the ''Ducky'' '''Gladiator''' had duck-themed cosmetics that were removed when the {{Color|Other|Beach}} skin was added to the game.
*The {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} is based on the RED [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Scout Scout] from ''Team Fortress 2''.
**The bat used by the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin between Level 3-4 is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Bat Bat] that the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Scout Scout] uses.
**The boombox on the back of the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin may be based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Boston_Boom-Bringer Boston Boom-Bringer] cosmetic item for [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Scout Scout].
**The previous Level 5 bat is similar to the [[w:c:r2da:Classic|Classic]] [[w:c:r2da:Baseball Bat|Baseball Bat]] used in R2DA with the [[w:c:r2da:Barbed Wire|Barbed Wire]] attachment.
**The design of the bat used on Level 5 is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Atomizer Atomizer] bat usable by the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Scout Scout].
*The {{Color|Pumpkin|Pumpkin}} skin is heavily based on [[Lord Sinister]].
*The '''Gladiator''' previously shared its Level 2 icon with the [[Archer]]'s previous Level 3 icon.
**This is strange as the '''Gladiator''' did not have a ranged attack.
*The previous Level 5 {{Color|Spooky|Demon}} skin having red eyes is likely a reference to the first version of the Default Level 5 '''Gladiator''' having red eyes.
*On one of the renders used as background for Leaderboards, the Default skin is depicted to have a blue cape, which is never seen in game.
**As the render on Roblox is called "''VersusGraphic''", this is due to it being a reused image for the [[Versus]] mode, with cape colors representing the red and blue teams.
*On the render seen in the [[Gift Box]] after purchasing the ''Unwavering Tides Bundle'' [[Gamepasses|gamepass]], and the [[V1.8.4|Unwavering Tides Update]] thumbnail and trailer, the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Gladiator''' has flintlocks on its torso. However, these are not present on the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Gladiator''' in-game.
*The {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Gladiator''' skin is a reference to [[w:c:onepiece:Roronoa Zoro|Roronoa Zoro]] from ''One Piece''.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Galactic}} skin appearance is based on [[w:c:starwars:Sith Lord|Sith Lords]] from ''Star Wars'', though it does not appear to be based on any specific character.
*The blade used by the {{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}} skin may be a reference to the [[w:c:Cyberpunk:Mantis Blades|Mantis Blades]] from ''Cyberpunk 2077''.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Cameraman}} skin was originally meant to be released in the [[v1.17.2|April Fools 2024 Update]].
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Cameraman}} skin is based on the [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:Normal Cameraman|Cameramen]] from ''Skibidi Toilet''.
*The {{Color|Other|Beach}} skin's pool noodle make unique squeaking sounds when it hits an enemy, which differs from the other skins.
*The {{Color|Phantom}} skin's katana sheathe is likely heavily inspired by Murasama from ''Metal Gear Rising: Revengence''.

===Roblox Catalog===
*The {{RLinkC|125013769|Linked Sword}} (Level 0), {{RLinkC|10468915|Brigand's Sword}} (Original Level 2), {{RLinkC|68603324|Venomshank}} (Original Level 3), {{RLinkC|16641274|Illumina}} (Level 4) and {{RLinkC|16895215|Darkheart}} (Level 5) swords, which were used by the '''Gladiator''' at one point, are all gears found in the Roblox catalog.
** These swords are well known in Roblox's history. The Linked Sword was one of the six weapons in ''BrickBattle''. Brigand's Sword was the first gear ever published. The Venomshank, Illumina and Darkheart are unique swords from {{RLinkG|47324|''Sword Fight on the Heights IV''}}.
*The helmet that the Default skin uses between Level 2-4 is the {{RLinkC|10546552|Trojan Infantry Helmet}} from the Roblox catalog.
*Previously, the face used by the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin was the {{RLinkC|7074991|Fearless}} face from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 0-1 weapon used by the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin is the {{RLinkC|55301897|Baseball Bat}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
**The Level 2-4 baseball bats used are a re-textured version of it.
*The boombox on the back of the Level 5 {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin is the {{RLinkC|6096861739|Vibecaster Boombox}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The accessory was uploaded by BelowNatural over half a year after the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin was added to the game.
*The headset used by the level 5 {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin is the {{RLinkC|4036737464|Black Tactical Headset}} accessory from the Roblox Catalog.
*The Level 5 baseball cap used by the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin is the {{RLinkC|4820464967|Baseball Cap with Lightning Design}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 2+ shades used by the {{Color|Premium|Slugger}} skin are the {{RLinkC|67996377|Ice Cold Stunnas}} from the Roblox Catalog.
